about_the_game:
Unlock 7 new masks giving you thousands of new combinations to further customize your Shrieks and scare your friends! These masks will allow you to use the mods unlocked through playing the game to add even more variety to your Shriek!

This DLC unlocks the following:

  • Old Joe
  • The Mask
  • Spike
  • Chuckles
  • Slash
  • Meatface
  • Screaminator
